P1.4.text: World Leader In Industrial Process Heating

P1.6.text: Learn from Thermon engineers and product experts. Explore live sessions, visit us at industry events, or watch on-demand.

P1.7.text: From electric heat tracing to explosion-proof heaters, Thermon delivers engineered thermal solutions across every industry and environment.

P1.8.text: Electric heat, immersion, circulation, and specialty heaters for every industrial application.

P1.9.text: Electrical heat tracing cables, steam trace products, controls, and monitoring systems.

P1.10.text: Explosion-proof and rugged heating solutions engineered for the harshest transportation environments.

P1.11.text: General purpose and hazardous location power distribution panels and accessories for project sites.

P1.12.text: Electrically heated, steam, and pre-insulated tubing bundles with complete system accessories.

P1.13.text: Precision thermal management solutions designed to protect critical data center infrastructure.

P1.14.text: Heated flat blankets and container temperature control for custom industrial heating needs.

P1.15.text: Steam, hot water, and electrode boilers plus ancillary equipment for precision thermal processes.

P1.16.text: High-performance steam, hot oil, and hot water boilers with superheaters and ancillary systems.

P1.17.text: Our customers rely on us to provide high quality, safe, reliable and environmentally responsible solutions for their heating needs.

P1.18.text: Whether you’re looking for complete flow assurance, industrial heating, temperature maintenance, freeze protection or environmental monitoring, Thermon has you covered.

P1.19.text: We proudly celebrate our 70th anniversary! Since our founding in by Richard Burdick, Thermon has been dedicated to innovation in heat transfer solutions.

P1.20.text: From introducing heat transfer cement to pioneering the first packaged tracing systems and developing high-performance heating technologies, we’ve consistently pushed the boundaries to meet our customers’ needs

P1.2.text: SUPERIOR PIPING SOLUTIONS THAT EXCEED EXPECTATIONS

P1.3.text: At PERMA-PIPE International Holdings, Inc., integrity is at the core of everything we do. We deliver durable, high-performance pipe systems that meet the toughest standards while continuously innovating to enhance quality, efficiency, and sustainability.

P1.4.text: With expertise in anti-corrosion coatings, insulation solutions, containment systems, custom fabrication, leak detection systems, and comprehensive technical support, field service, and logistics, we’re ready to be your trusted partner in piping system solutions.

P1.5.text: Let’s build the future of pipe systems—together.

P1.6.text: Supporting the Industries That Keep the World Moving

P1.7.text: Efficient Energy Distribution District energy systems use pre-insulated piping to transport steam, hot water, and chilled water, providing reliable heating and cooling for commercial and industrial sites. They optimize performance, reduce costs, and enhance energy efficiency and sustainability at scale.

P1.8.text: Reliable Piping Solutions From energy production to essential manufacturing, the energy and industrial sector drives modern economies and demands safe, reliable transport solutions. PERMA-PIPE’s pre-insulated piping and containment systems provide robust, end-to-end sealing to prevent corrosion and ensure long-lasting durability.

P1.9.text: Essential Mining Solutions Reliable piping is essential for transporting water, slurry, chemicals, and gases in demanding mining conditions. Pre-insulated pipes offer a durable solution, protecting against damage, optimizing energy efficiency, and enhancing safety. Ideal for harsh climates and remote locations, they ensure long-term performance in extreme environments.

P1.10.text: The Solutions You Can Rely On.

P1.11.text: We deliver high-performance insulation solutions, reliable containment systems, top-tier anti-corrosion coatings, custom fabrication, and advanced leak detection technology. Trusted worldwide, our solutions go beyond materials—we collaborate with customers to create customized piping systems that exceed project requirements. With a focus on precision, reliability, and innovation, we tackle even the most complex challenges.

P1.12.text: PERMA-PIPE manufactures and supplies pre-insulated piping solutions, containment systems, anti-corrosion coatings, custom fabrication and leak detection systems, offering products tailored to meet client requirements and specifications. We support you at every stage, providing expert planning, engineering and technical assistance, material consulting, specification guidance, calculations, logistics, and dedicated project management. With a team of experienced professionals, we deliver customized solutions to keep your project on track—no matter the complexity.

P1.13.text: Count on us for high-quality products and services crafted to meet your exact requirements.

P1.14.text: PERMA-PIPE International Holdings, Inc. is a global leader in engineered pipe services, specializing in anti-corrosion coatings, insulation solutions, containment systems, custom fabrication, leak detection, technical support, field service, and logistics.

P2.3.text: At PERMA-PIPE, we pride ourselves on being a worldwide leader in engineered piping solutions. Our expertise spans anti-corrosion coatings, advanced insulation solutions, containment systems, custom fabrication, and cutting-edge leak detection technology.

P2.4.text: With decades of industry experience and certifications in ISO 9001, 14001, and 45001, we are committed to delivering reliable, high-performance solutions tailored to the unique demands of every project, no matter how complex.

P2.5.text: From initial concept to final implementation, our comprehensive suite of services is crafted to exceed expectations, ensuring smooth execution and exceptional results. When you choose PERMA-PIPE, you’re partnering with a team that combines unparalleled expertise, innovation, and dedication to driving your project’s success.

P2.6.text: Discover the PERMA-PIPE difference — where innovation and reliability flow together seamlessly.

P2.7.text: XTRU-THERM features thermally efficient polyurethane (PUR) insulation, a waterproof high-density polyethylene (HDPE) outer jacket, and a durable service pipe.

P2.8.text: Each component is fabricated in an ISO 9000 facility to ensure top-quality control.

P2.9.text: Polyurethane insulation is gap-free and securely attached to the pipe and jacket, ensuring consistent thermal performance.

P2.10.text: The watertight outer jacket prevents corrosion under insulation (CUI), reducing the need for inspections, repairs, replacements, and downtime.

P2.11.text: The insulation provides long-term reliability with materials and techniques that minimize damage during construction and operation, maximizing investment returns.
